title: Seven Days in Tanzania: A Sample Route
excerpt: A sample seven-day route through northern Tanzania: Tarangire, the Serengeti and the Ngorongoro Crater at a relaxed pace.
body:
Seven days is enough for a beautiful safari through the northern circuit.

## Day 1: arrival in Arusha

Pick-up at Kilimanjaro Airport and a night in Arusha or a lodge nearby.

## Day 2: Tarangire

A full day in [Tarangire](/blog/tarangire-national-park-guide/), with elephants and baobabs.

## Day 3: to the Serengeti

Via the Ngorongoro highlands and [Olduvai Gorge](/blog/olduvai-gorge-guide/) to the Serengeti, with a game drive on the way.

## Day 4–5: Serengeti

Two full days in the region that fits the season. See [the regions](/blog/serengeti-regions-explained/).

## Day 6: Ngorongoro Crater

Morning game drive on the crater floor, night on the rim or in Karatu.

## Day 7: back to Arusha

Lunch in Arusha and departure, or extension to Zanzibar.

## Variations

- Fly from the Serengeti to save a long drive back.
- Add [Lake Manyara](/blog/lake-manyara-guide/) or [Lake Eyasi](/blog/lake-eyasi-guide/).

This is an example; we adapt every route. [Plan your seven days](/travel-proposal/).
